t: An open-source DIY smartwatch with a touchscreen, Wi-Fi, and motion sensors.
steps: Buy the TinyWATCH S3 from the Unexpected Maker shop or Lectronz, checking that it ships to your country.
Buy a small LiPo battery no larger than the 602530 size and a 20 mm watch strap.
Fit the battery and strap to the watch case.
Install VS Code and the PlatformIO extension.
Download the official firmware from the TinyWATCH S3 GitHub page.
Build and upload the firmware over USB-C.
Try one of the example projects and change a watch face color.
